sentences.text:
M/S Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages ... vs The State Of
Jharkhand And Other .... ... on 16 June, 2023

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 1
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 ----
Cr.M.P. No. 2111 of 2012
----
M/s Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Private Limited .... Petitioner
-- Versus --
The State of Jharkhand and Other .... Opposite Parties

---- 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
 For the Petitioner :- Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate
 For the State :- Ms Kumari Rashmi, Advocate
 ----
5/16.06.2023 Heard Mr. Indrajit Sinha, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. Kumari Rashmi, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent State.

2. This petition has been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding in connection with PFA Case No.48 of 2004 including the order whereby the discharge petition filed by the petitioner has been rejected dated 07.07.2012 by learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad, pending before the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad.

3. At the outset Mr. Indrajit Sinha, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that this petition is fit to be allowed considering analyst report dated 4.9.2003 contained at page no.36 of the petition.

He submits that the product of Thumps Up was seized by the public analyst at Gomoh M/S Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Other .... ... on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131690551/
1 railway station.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that however the public analyst of Bihar has given the report which is not acceptable in view of section 8 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1950.
4. The learned court has been pleased to take cognizance under section 16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1950 and summoned the petitioner to face the trial.
However, in the meantime, the petitioner has moved before this Court and interim protection has been granted.
The contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner has not been demolished by the argument made by the learned counsel for the respondent.

Section 8 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1950 with respect to local area may be assigned to them by the Central Government or the State Government.

It is admitted position that the public analyst at Patna was not assigned to the local area of Gomoh which comes within the jurisdiction of the State of Jharkhand and therefore he has no authority to give any analyst report in respect of sample collected at Gomoh in the State of Jharkhand and this fact is not denied in the argument of learned counsel for the respondent State.
5. In view of the above being the position the report of chemical analysis of the product Thumps Up collected from Gomoh railway station cannot be the analysis by a public analyst of the State of Bihar.
6.

Accordingly, the entire criminal proceeding in connection with PFA Case No.48 of 2004 including the order dated 07.07.2012 whereby the discharge petition filed by the petitioner has been rejected by learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad, pending before the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad is quashed.
7. This petition is allowed and disposed of.
8. Pending petition, if any also stands disposed of.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/
